important_dates.interview_date: Not specified - dates to be notified on Departmental Notice Boards and the official website

age_limit.age_details: Purely temporary and voluntary; deployed under 'Wages', Highly Skilled Category
age_limit.details: The upper age limit of applicants should not exceed 50 years as on 1st September 2026.

qualification.details: The applicant must be a trained Home Guards Volunteer. The applicant must be an Indian citizen. The applicant must be domiciled in the State of Meghalaya.

selection_process: The Personal Interview of eligible Home Guards Volunteers will be conducted at Tura and Shillong centres. No separate intimation regarding interviews will be sent. It is the responsibility of candidates/volunteers to check the selected list and appear for the interview on the dates notified on the Departmental Notice Boards and the official website (www.meghomeguards.gov.in). Volunteers should carry valid ID cards for identification and present original documents to the Board during the Personal Interview.
how_to_apply: Obtain the Prescribed Standard Form for enrolment.

Fill the form and attach 2 copies of a recent passport-size photograph (pasting one on the form), along with attested copies of the Educational Qualification Certificate, Birth/Age Certificate, EPIC card of Meghalaya, Home Guards Basic Training Certificate, and Medical Fitness Certificate.

Submit the completed application to the respective District Home Guards Office, Officers Commanding District Training Centre, or Civil Defence Office from where you are being deployed with various Requisitioning Agencies, on or before 28th September 2026.

Detailed notice can also be accessed at the offices of the District Home Guards Commandant (Shillong, Jowai, Tura), District Training Centres (Nongpoh, Nongstoin, Williamnagar, Baghmara, Khliehriat, Mawkyrwat, Ampati, Resubelpara), Civil Defence Offices, the Central Training Institute (Mawdiangdiang, Shillong), the Deputy Commissioner's office of all Districts, and the Departmental website.
important_instructions: The Department shall not be responsible for any damage or injury to volunteers during the enrolment process. Volunteers should come duly prepared to stay for 2/3 days under their own arrangements; no TA/DA will be admissible for the journey or stay. Canvassing, directly or indirectly, will lead to disqualification of the candidate/volunteer; any volunteer found offering a bribe to anyone involved in the enrolment process, or to a person in authority, shall be disqualified and/or prosecuted. The Department reserves the right to cancel the enrolment process wholly or partially, without assigning any reasons. State Reservation Policy/Roster will not be applicable to this enrolment, as the deployment is purely voluntary.

content_sections.heading: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: State Reservation Policy/Roster will not be applicable to this enrolment, since the deployment is purely voluntary.

content_sections.heading: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a trained Home Guards Volunteer. The applicant must be an Indian citizen. The applicant must be domiciled in the State of Meghalaya.

content_sections.heading: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit of applicants should not exceed 50 years as on 1st September 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 Nature of Engagement
content_sections.text: Volunteers will be deployed under 'Wages', Highly Skilled Category, at the rate prescribed by the Department of Labour, Employment & Skill Development, Govt. of Meghalaya, from time to time, including the Risk Allowance prescribed by the State Government, paid as monthly Honoraria. The deployment period is for 1 (one) year, which may be extended based on the volunteer's performance in the assigned task. The deployment is purely temporary and voluntary; no volunteer can claim regularization or permanent retention. Deployed volunteers can be dismissed or terminated at any time without assigning any reason. Selected/successful volunteers must serve anywhere in the remote border areas of Khasi, Jaintia & Garo Hills bordering Bangladesh. Specific wage/honorarium figures are not stated in this notice and are determined by the Department of Labour, Employment & Skill Development, Govt. of Meghalaya, from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: The application, filed in the Standard Form, must be submitted along with attested copies of the following certificates/documents: 2 (two) copies of a recent passport-size photograph, one of which is to be pasted on the Standard Form Educational Qualification Certificate Birth Certificate or Age Certificate as per school records EPIC (Electors Photo Identity Card) of Meghalaya Home Guards Basic Training Certificate Medical Fitness Certificate from any Authorized Government Medical Practitioner/Institution Completed applications, accompanied by self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials, should be submitted to the respective District Home Guards Office, Officers Commanding District Training Centre, or Civil Defence Office from where the applicant is being deployed with various Requisitioning Agencies.

content_sections.heading: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Personal Interview of eligible Home Guards Volunteers will be conducted at Tura and Shillong centres. No separate intimation regarding interviews will be sent. It is the responsibility of candidates/volunteers to check the selected list and appear for the interview on the dates notified on the Departmental Notice Boards and the official website (www.meghomeguards.gov.in). Volunteers should carry valid ID cards for identification and present original documents to the Board during the Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an enrolment notice from the Civil Defence & Home Guards Department, Meghalaya, for 558 Part-Time Guardsman and Equivalent Ranks (Volunteers) posts in the Meghalaya Border Wing Home Guards Battalion.

faq.question: Q2. How many posts are available?
faq.answer: 558 posts of Part-Time Guardsman and Equivalent Ranks (Volunteers).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the concerned District Home Guards Office/Training Centre/Civil Defence Office on or before 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Trained Home Guards Volunteers who are Indian citizens domiciled in the State of Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit should not exceed 50 years as on 1st September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By submitting the Prescribed Standard Form, with attested copies of the required certificates, to the respective District Home Guards Office, Officers Commanding District Training Centre, or Civil Defence Office.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A Personal Interview conducted at Tura and Shillong centres; no separate intimation is sent, and candidates must check the selected list on notice boards or the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the deployment period and where will volunteers serve?
faq.answer: The deployment period is 1 year, extendable based on performance. Selected volunteers must serve in the remote border areas of Khasi, Jaintia & Garo Hills bordering Bangladesh.
